subject: LINAGE clause
notes: kb/Work PB524 (landed): with integer-1 and integer-2 both literals, FOOTING greater than the page size is refused at compile time under COBOL2025 (it used to reach run time and throw a CLR InvalidOperationException); the equality boundary (FOOTING AT 4 on a page of 4) compiles and runs in the positive golden. A data-name on either side makes the relation a run-time value governed by 13.18.34.4 GR3, outside this syntax rule.
